codings.one_line: Apple Intelligence's email-prioritization feature flagged phishing/scam emails as high-priority messages.
codings.rationale: Email prioritization is a ranking/classification system, explicitly excluded from scope under the recommender/ranking-system carve-out in criterion 2.

codings.one_line: Apple's iPhone dictation feature briefly substituted 'Trump' for the word 'racist' due to a speech-recognition bug.
codings.rationale: Voice dictation/transcription is not a conversational or agentic system interacting with users under any listed category; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: The LA Times' AI 'Insights' feature (built by Perplexity) generated a sympathetic characterization of the KKK on an opinion column.
codings.rationale: An automatically generated content sidebar shown to all readers is not a chatbot/voice agent/customer-service/dev-tool/autonomous agent responding to a specific user's input; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: Amazon's AI review summary called Mein Kampf 'a true work of art,' which Google then surfaced as a search featured snippet.
codings.rationale: An automated public-facing review-summarization/search-snippet pipeline is not conversational/agentic interaction with an individual user; resembles the excluded recommender/ranking category.

codings.one_line: AI-generated avatar 'doctors' on TikTok used fake credentials and scripted videos to spread dubious health advice.
codings.rationale: Scripted AI avatar videos are synthetic-media content generation by third-party creators, explicitly excluded from scope, and not an interactive conversational/agentic system.

codings.one_line: Apple's voicemail transcription inserted explicit and insulting language into a routine garage voicemail message.
codings.rationale: Voicemail transcription is a passive speech-to-text tool, not a chatbot/voice agent/customer-service/dev-tool/autonomous agent interacting with a user; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: Predictive text/AI autocomplete was inadvertently left enabled during the NAPLAN writing exam at two Sydney schools, forcing retakes.
codings.rationale: This is a configuration/administrative failure to disable an autocomplete feature, not an AI system responding to a discernible adversarial/social/normative input; fails scope criteria 1 and 3.

codings.one_line: Xanthorox AI, a self-built malicious AI platform, surfaced on darknet forums as an all-in-one cyberattack toolkit.
codings.rationale: This is a purpose-built malicious tool rather than a deployed conversational/agentic system serving ordinary end users that failed due to an input; fails scope criterion 1.

codings.one_line: Security researchers jailbroke the Lovable AI app-builder to generate and host live phishing pages in a benchmark study.
codings.rationale: This was a benchmark/red-team evaluation (Guardio's VibeScamming Benchmark) with no documented deployed-user harm, which the rubric explicitly excludes from scope.

codings.one_line: An attorney's AI-drafted legal filing to Norway's Supreme Court contained fabricated case citations, caught during internal review.
codings.rationale: Ordinary professional use of an AI tool for legal drafting (would pass unnoticed as routine practice) produced hallucinated citations: normative/C; no sanction was issued so harm is reputational.
